## Changes

- Start the saved movie or episode directly from Continue Watching, preserving source selection.
- Remove completed movies and fully watched series from the watchlist, including watched status synced from Trakt.
- Add long-press actions to Home catalog cards for trailers and watchlist changes. Continue Watching cards show playback details, an available cached pause frame, and a confirmed Clear Progress action.
- Add TV-native coverflow motion to catalog rows, smoother background transitions, and stronger focus zoom for shared cards and buttons.

## Verification And Limitations

The release Kotlin compile and unit tests passed locally. Remote long-press timing, playback handoff, and visual motion still need physical TV verification.
